label: Red Curtain
description: Deep red velvet folds, lit to glow. Our most recognisable backdrop, with the drama of an old cinema and the intimacy of a closed booth.

label: White Marble
description: A pale marble wall that keeps every frame bright and clean. Gentle on skin tones, timeless in print.

label: Stars
description: A field of black stars on white. Graphic, a little rebellious, and made for pulling faces with your favourite people.

label: Custom for Events
description: For private celebrations and brand events, the backdrop can be shaped around your theme, so every print carries the story of the night.
